grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 13014 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, meaning every row is a distinct physical reading; airport_code has distinct_count 3 and observed_hour_utc has distinct_count 4341, whose product (13023) closely matches row_count, so one row is one airport's hourly weather observation and the airport_code plus observed_hour_utc tuple absorbs the grain without needing aggregation.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter station code (EWR, JFK, LGA) with null_rate 0.0, identifying which airport the reading belongs to.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: Hourly UTC timestamp (samples all end in :00:00, min 2013-01-01T06:00:00, max 2013-07-01T03:00:00) that times each weather observation; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation (181 distinct values spanning 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30) with null_rate 0.0, provided as a coarser local-date attribute alongside the UTC time column.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day label (0-23, 24 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, describing when locally the reading was taken rather than a quantity to aggregate.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in Fahrenheit (samples 10.94 to 93.92, 130 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a measured quantity suitable for averaging across readings.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in Fahrenheit (samples -9.94 to 73.94, 119 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a measured atmospheric quantity.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage (samples 12.74 to 100.0, 2178 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a measured quantity.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (samples 0 to 360, 37 distinct values) with null_rate 0.016828, nullable likely during calm conditions when direction is undefined; treated as a circular label rather than a summable measure.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Sustained wind speed in mph (samples 0.0 to 1048.36058, 36 distinct values) with null_rate 0.000154, a measured quantity with rare missing readings.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in mph (samples 16.11092 to 62.14212, 35 distinct values) with null_rate 0.745505, nullable because gusts are only recorded when they occur.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches (samples 0.0 to 1.06, 50 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a measured accumulation quantity.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars (samples 983.8 to 1038.4, 430 distinct values) with null_rate 0.114953, a measured quantity missing for some readings.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility distance in miles (distinct_values 0.0 through 10.0, 20 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a measured quantity.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport) with null_rate 0.0, a descriptive attribute of the airport.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality hosting the airport (New York, Newark, 2 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a descriptive location attribute.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet (distinct_values 13, 18, 21) with null_rate 0.0, a fixed airport attribute rather than a per-reading measure.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet (distinct_values 7002, 11000, 14511) with null_rate 0.0, a fixed airport attribute rather than a measured quantity.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Technical capture timestamp (only 3 distinct values clustered around 2026-09-02T23:26:11 to 2026-09-02T23:26:13) with null_rate 0.0, recording when the row was captured by the pipeline rather than the business event time.

category_description: One row represents a single hourly weather observation recorded at one of the three New York area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), carrying the station's atmospheric readings for that hour.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_readings fact category, stating its grain, time column, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models from it.
usage: The rendered mapping contract is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted with datacontract lint, and reviewed by a human before approval; only after approval does the modeling engine consume it to emit the gold fact and its dimensions.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or reconcile the 0.745505 null_rate on wind_gust_mph, the 0.114953 null_rate on pressure_mb, or the 0.016828 null_rate on wind_dir_degrees; consumers must decide how to treat missing atmospheric readings, and no quality rule, severity, or ownership metadata is declared here by design.
